deviations_from_card: Not landed: the first-paint ceiling breach could not be removed. The built version differs from the card in three ways. (1) useVoicePhase lives in bell/voice-phase.ts and listens on athena:face itself through lib/ipc, reading the phase only. It does not use mainFaceSource, because a static lib/face import puts lib/face into the first frame. FACE_EVENT is spelled a second time and a test pins it to lib/face's constant. (2) createVoicePhase(source, onPhase) returns its stop. It does not take a clock argument; fake timers drive the global setTimeout. (3) The console's dock text and the surface headline say 'speaking' / 'Athena is speaking' when the pose is speaking, instead of pillText's 'Athena is resting'.
